title: Appointed as Assistant
original: Aw, c'mon, get someone more literate for this job. I'm a soldier, all I know is following orders. Paperwork's beyond me.

title: Talk 1
original: Life is tough enough already. Let's relax with some butter, frosting and jam.

title: Talk 2
original: If Frostleaf wasn't still lugging that big axe around, there's no way I would've recognized her. We fought together before, probably as enemies. Anyway, I'm relieved to see her living the good life at Rhodes Island.

title: Talk 3
original: Watch it, Doctor, you can't go touching my weapon. I just replaced the Originium on that thing. It's dangerous when you hold it wrong... Look out! I, I'll take you to Medical...

title: Talk after Promotion 1
original: Defensive ability is what matters to a Defender. I don't care if it's organic fiber or ceramic padding, as long as it's the state-of-the-art, just buy it!

title: Talk after Promotion 2
original: Stories from my past? Umm… Don't have much to say. I mean, what kind of story could a bad tempered soldier have? All those merits and medals... Hmph, they're nothing in the face of the lives lost.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
original: The greenies we got in the reserves are pretty good. But they suck at securing amenities. Back in my day, the rookies were way smarter about hiding cookies.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
original: I talked to Logistics. From now on, they're putting 'Industrial Material' on all our snack packaging. Then, all we need is you to sign off on them for us, Doctor.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
original: Doctor? Oh, sorry. I was all caught up in reminiscing. I still can't get past certain things. If my old commander was anything like you, maybe... We wouldn't have had to go through that.

title: Idle
original: Psst, Psst! Want some pop rocks? I got all kinds. I know I got one you'll love.

title: Onboard
original: Hard as rock and lethal as lightning! That's me, Dur-nar. Nice to meet you, Doctor.

title: Watching Battle Record
original: Ah, shoot, I'm out of popcorn.

title: Promotion 1
original: A promotion? Good, good, do I get paid more too? Awesome!

title: Promotion 2
original: The old me only knew how to charge on ahead and fight without stopping. Now, I fight for everybody. Just give your orders, Doctor.

title: Added to Squad
original: Ready to deploy. Where am I needed?

title: Appointed as Squad Leader
original: I only have one request: Safety first and don't ever forget it.

title: Depart
original: We're off! Remember to stay frosty and keep an eye out.

title: Begin Operation
original: I never did get used to the stench of war.

title: Selecting Operator 1
original: Yes sir!

title: Selecting Operator 2
original: In position!

title: Deployment 1
original: I'll leave the support to you.

title: Deployment 2
original: Cover me!

title: In Battle 1
original: Hold the line!

title: In Battle 2
original: Don't be an idiot!

title: In Battle 3
original: Ya ain't gettin' through me!

title: In Battle 4
original: Stay down!

title: 4-star Result
original: Ever heard of the Medal of Glory? I feel that's tailor-made for you.

title: 3-star Result
original: No need to clean up the battlefield? Okay, then we're done here.

title: Sub 3-star Result
original: The enemy still hasn't gone far. Should we chase them down?

title: Operation Failure
original: Take it easy, Doctor. It's not your fault...

title: Assigned to Facility
original: Whoa, I bet a fancy interior like this cost a bundle!

title: Tap
original: Hmph, Who the--

title: Trust Tap
original: You must be drunk to want to hear me sing war songs. Okay, don't you regret it.

title: Title
original: Arknights.

title: New Year's blessing
original: Happy New Year! I can finally lay my snacks out for everyone to eat with pride! Medical won't be so cruel on today of all days, right? I've been looking forward to this cake forever, *homp*—oooh, it's amazing! Doctor, move that fork quick or all you get is crumbs~

title: Greeting
original: Good morning!

title: Birthday
original: As thanks for always getting us off the hook, here's a present I brought in for you. But first, sign here. I guarantee it's all above board—signed? Great! I'll take this down to Dobermann! A permit for building a snack cupboard, signed by the Doctor!

title: Anniversary Celebration
original: Huh? It's not often I see you at the bar, Doctor. What's wrong, trouble at work? You're a great commander, I don't want you taking any wrong turns any time soon. Come on, I'll order you an 'Iceflame,' and we'll talk over drinks?
